description: Header file defining functions and structures for parsing and validating NMEA0183 GNSS messages, including checksum computation, message validation, and parsing of RMC, GGA, and GSV messages.

classes.name: gnss_nmea0183_gsv_header
classes.description: Structure representing the header of an NMEA0183 GSV message, including system, message count, message number, and satellite count.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_checksum
methods.description: Computes the checksum for a given NMEA0183 string.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_snprintk
methods.description: Encapsulates a formatted string into an NMEA0183 message format.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_validate_message
methods.description: Validates the checksum of an NMEA0183 message split into arguments.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_ddmm_mmmm_to_ndeg
methods.description: Parses a ddmm.mmmm formatted angle string into nano degrees.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_knots_to_mms
methods.description: Converts speed in knots to millimeters per second.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_hhmmss
methods.description: Parses hhmmss.sss formatted time into a gnss_time structure.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_ddmmyy
methods.description: Parses a ddmmyy date string into day, month, year components.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_rmc
methods.description: Parses an NMEA0183 RMC message into gnss_data structure.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_gga
methods.description: Parses an NMEA0183 GGA message into gnss_data structure.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_gsv_header
methods.description: Parses the header of an NMEA0183 GSV message.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_gsv_svs
methods.description: Parses satellite information from an NMEA0183 GSV message.
